U.note: Large, well-outlined pelican with wing gripping the bars, IK legs, spinning spokes, visible bell with ding bubble, road-scroll toggle, good phone layout and reduced-motion handling.

V.note: Clean parallax scene with trees and clouds and a charming pelican, but the bike is small, the wing does not reach the grip, and the bell gives only text feedback.

W.note: Helmeted pelican with wing on the bars, honk visual, live readout and keyboard shortcuts; cadence reads 0 at start and the readout text is tiny on mobile.

X.note: Attractive scene with helmet and trees, but the arm is a thin stub, the bell is a checkbox whose puff effect is barely visible, and the pelican is small.

Y.note: Many features (night mode, reverse, synth bell) but the pelican looks blobby, the legs and feet are crude, and the grey-green ground band is awkward.

Z.note: Cute thick-outlined pelican and a visible bell, but the sky is plain, the wing hangs behind rather than gripping the bars, and the scenery is sparse.
